text:
sasha: FYI at 14:02 UTC our infra team flagged a precautionary emergency deploy targeting model-routing in apac to fix a fallback loop. Ops asked us to pause all outbound launches and benchmark posts for APAC audiences until it's validated. Please hold anything scheduled in the next 6 hours.

deploy-bot: [deploy] emergency_deploy_model_routing started at 14:03 UTC (deploy id: dpl-9876). Rolling across apac clusters; expected validation window 30-60m.

tom: Copy. I'll pause the paid social flight and the organic launch thread. Can we also delay the benchmark blog which references APAC p95 numbers? We shouldn't publish region-specific numbers while routing is unstable.

rachel: Agreed on the benchmark. For public status copy I want something concise that doesn't over-explain but gives customers direction. Draft:```Status: Investigating
Summary: We're validating an emergency routing fix in APAC that may affect inference latency for a subset of customers. Engineers are monitoring performance.
Next update: ~30 minutes.
Impact: Some APAC customers may experience elevated latency or retries.``` Thoughts?

ana: (typo correction) ana: small note: avoid saying "emergency deploy" on the public page. Use "validation of a routing update" instead. Also recommend we add a customer-facing mitigation tip: "If you observe errors, retry with backoff or pin to a non-APAC region temporarily."

sasha: Good call. Revised status copy with mitigation tip:```Status: Investigating
Summary: We're validating a routing update in APAC that may cause elevated latency or transient errors for a subset of customers. Engineers are monitoring and validating traffic.
What you can do: If you experience errors, retry with exponential backoff or route requests to a different region.
Next update: ~30 minutes.
Impact: Elevated latency and transient errors for some APAC inference requests.``` (no mention of "emergency").

tom: Marketing actions: 1) Pause paid social and org posts for APAC, 2) Hold benchmark blog until resolution, 3) Delay any launch email targeted to APAC by 24 hours, 4) Notify partners/affiliates privately. I'll execute 1-3 now.

rachel: CS templates - short and sweet:```Hi — thanks for the report. We're validating a routing update in APAC that may have caused elevated latency or transient errors. If you can share request IDs we'll prioritize your case. In the meantime, retries with backoff or routing to another region may help. Sorry for the disruption.``` Please push to support templates.

ana: Also ping sales ops: some scheduled demos in APAC might be impacted. Recommend offering flexible reschedules and an opt-in for a recorded walkthrough if customers prefer not to reschedule.

sasha: I've published the initial status entry at 14:07 UTC with the revised language (no mention of "emergency"). Holding the launch sends across APAC.

deploy-bot: [deploy] validation_passed on 14:28 UTC for primary cluster. Secondary clusters validating; overall roll still in progress.

tom: Nice. Hold on marketing reschedule — let's wait for the validation window to fully clear. If the roll finishes cleanly and we get 15m stable telemetry, we can re-open the queue and schedule APAC sends +2h to be safe.

rachel: Agreed. When marking "Resolved" we should include a brief post-incident note that explains the root cause in non-technical terms (routing policy update caused a fallback loop) and actions (improved rollout checks, extra canary coverage). No need to deep-dive publicly.

ana: For partners/affiliates DM: short note that we delayed APAC launch & benchmarks due to validation; will share new schedule when we hit stable state. Offer to coordinate alternate windows.

sasha: Validation window completed for all clusters by 14:40 UTC. Telemetry looks stable; p95 and error rates back to baseline. Running a 15m smoke window.

tom: If smoke window stays green, approve reschedule for APAC sends +2h (to give CS time to update templates and Sales to reach out). Also recommend we alert the paid media team to re-run targeting checks before pushing live.

rachel: Smoke window green at 14:56 UTC (no regressions). Draft resolution copy for statuspage:```Status: Resolved
Summary: We validated and rolled out a routing update in APAC that briefly caused elevated latency and transient errors for some customers. Engineers rolled back the fallback logic and completed validation; service is operating normally.
Timeline: Validation began 14:03 UTC, mitigation/validation completed 14:40 UTC, fully validated by 14:56 UTC.
Follow-up: We're updating rollout checks and canary coverage to prevent recurrence. If you experienced issues, please contact support with request IDs.```

ana: Approved. Tom: you can re-open APAC sends +2h and resume benchmark scheduling for non-APAC numbers immediately. Keep APAC benchmark posts delayed until we re-run the tests in 48h.

sasha: Published resolution at 14:57 UTC and posted CS template to the support queue. Paused launch sends re-opened for +2h. I'll also post the brief post-incident note in #postmortems later today.

tom: Done — re-opened scheduled sends for 16:57 UTC and notified paid team. I'll hold an extra check at T-30m before send.

rachel: Closing loop here. Thanks for quick turnaround everyone. We'll keep the postmortem light and marketing-focused. :white_check_mark:
